recipes.flavor: Selyna's everyday brew — berries baked over gem-heat until they hold together.
recipes.use: A full meal for any dragon, and Eleanor never refuses one.

recipes.flavor: Boil a bound faggot until the salt lets go, and it comes out the shape a hull wants.
recipes.use: The wrecks give up strakes far too slowly to build on.

recipes.flavor: A cluster of frost flowers, simmered until only the fibre is left.
recipes.use: Thread without waiting on a full Rime Bloom to grow one.

recipes.flavor: Two knots of tar and two spars of wood: the wood is what makes it burn slow.
recipes.use: The north's fuel. Dragons eat it; boats are sealed with it.

recipes.flavor: Pitch for the burning, spirit for the light, and a wick of anything to hand.
recipes.use: Three make a Storm Lantern. Only a handful were ever left on the ice.

recipes.flavor: Two mana pebbles quarrelling over one strake of wreck timber, until one of them wins and points.
recipes.use: The road to a Wayfinder, which pays in coin forever.

recipes.flavor: Two threads and a cluster to hold them apart while they set.
recipes.use: Three make a Light-Fast Spindle — what Selyna's last order asks for.

recipes.flavor: A Black Ember burns hot enough to split a nodule clean, and clean is the whole art.
recipes.use: Three shards begin a second Runestone — and a Runestone makes tar forever.

recipes.flavor: Board the wood, seal it with a warm gem, and the isle fills it on its own.
recipes.use: Opens into coins, rubies, or a rare find.

recipes.flavor: Two rubies remember being one heart. The preserve is for the first thing it asks.
recipes.use: Three Red Eggs merge into a Red Dragon.

recipes.flavor: Moonwater poured over sweetness until something green agrees to grow a shell.
recipes.use: Three Green Eggs merge into a Green Dragon.

recipes.flavor: Ash wants tar, tar wants fire, and a Radiant Gem is the only fire that burns slow enough.
recipes.use: Legendary. Three Ashdrake Eggs wake the Ashdrake.

recipes.flavor: Wind the spindle, sink it in moonwater, and let the frost do the remembering.
recipes.use: Legendary. Three Rimewyrm Eggs wake the Rimewyrm.

recipes.flavor: Fire that keeps, frost that keeps, and enough moonlight to make them agree. Gold is what agreement looks like.
recipes.use: Mythic. The rarest shell the cauldron knows.
